Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Health Check Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop visibility diagnostic screen before waiting to test desktop window permissions and rendering display engines. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open, and waiting screen median time is 201s.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Post Pet Adoption Certificate: Reorder the sign-in step to take place immediately after completing the pet adoption certificate. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after re-signing in; moving sign-in right after certificate creation links the named pet profile securely.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Path Decision Comparison Screen: Add an interactive preview screen before path selection showcasing live comparisons between instant pre-made pets and custom photo-created pets. (why: choose_path has a 23.8% drop-off rate and a high mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion about available choices.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Returning Account Pet Recovery Warning: Add a prominent account sync warning hint on the sign-in screen urging returning users to select the same provider to avoid pet resets. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account confusion the largest single support issue.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Outcome Clarity Copy: Update headline and body on choose_path screen to explicitly detail setup time and photo requirements for both paths. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a 514s mean time, showing hesitation over what each path requires.)
5: [home, wait_info] Multi-Stage Asset Rendering Progress Tracker: Upgrade waiting screen with live asset rendering step indicators and time estimates. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s and median 201s, causing user frustration.)

Reordering sign-in directly targets major reset issue (8 emails), but structural changes carry risk.
Adding a comparison screen may resolve path confusion but adds extra step complexity.
High impact hint directly addressing the top support complaint (8 emails) with low effort.

Progress tracker directly alleviates frustration during the lengthy 201s/2336s waiting step.
